description: This file contains unit tests for the ImageAspectRatio validation rule in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding API. It tests the validation of image aspect ratios based on provided image properties and expected validity.

classes.name: ImageAspectRatioTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the ImageAspectRatio validation rule, testing various aspect ratios against different image data inputs.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Unit test method that checks if the ImageAspectRatio validation correctly determines whether an image's aspect ratio matches the expected ratio based on given file properties and content.

methods.name: dataProvider
methods.description: Provides different sets of data for testing various aspect ratio validation scenarios.
